insights.summary: Per attendee notes of the 6 Nov 2026 call, Symbiotec's Q2 FY27 revenue was ₹280 Cr (+43%, including ₹53 Cr of milestone revenue from a new US dual-chamber vial agreement) and PAT ₹52 Cr. FY27 guidance of about 20% revenue growth and 25% EBITDA growth (plus or minus 5 points) was maintained. New-business revenue is expected in 6-12 months, with the European CDMO's best year in FY29.

what_changed.text: FY27 guidance of about 20% revenue and 25% EBITDA growth
Long-term agreement signed 30 Sep 2026 for two US dual-chamber vial products; ₹53 Cr milestone revenue booked in Q2
Binding 10-year take-or-pay with a European alternative-protein customer; Phase 1 at 750 KL (up from 600 KL)
Insulin drug-substance commissioning in Q4 FY27 after a couple of months' delay

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Management view: Injectables and CDMO can scale to a size comparable to the API business over the coming years

analyst_questions.answer: A large milestone invoice was raised on 30 Sep; to normalise next quarter.
Price pressure continues; growth is volume-led; 70% regulated markets.
Only piloted, funded partners with take-or-pay contracts with large corporates.

red_flags.text: Q2 revenue includes a ₹53 Cr one-off-style milestone; milestones are lumpy.
New businesses cost ₹57 Cr of opex and ₹24 Cr of depreciation in H1 with no revenue yet.
Net debt ₹314 Cr and capex rising to ₹1,672 Cr gross by FY27-end.
Gross margin hit 2-3 points by solvent and logistics costs.

watch_next: Second ANDA filing in Q4 FY27
